purpose: Evaluate exact-checkpoint predictor-member posterior spread and applicability calibration on the independent calibration partition. This is experimental framework evidence only and cannot reverse Gate 0 v5, promote the CAE, transfer parameters, implement the complete 082611 strategy, or perform 082612 formal acceptance.

partition.policy: design-row-only; every rawData field and coordinate follows its design
partition.development: development train_pool fits weights/scalers; development validation is early-stopping only
partition.calibration: independent calibration locator only; two-fold design-level cross-fitting supplies out-of-fold evidence, then all 200 case designs refit the exact-checkpoint artifact
partition.test: offline-test remains unopened; formal test is deferred to 082612 after all decisions freeze

calibration.posterior_family: finite uniform predictor-member empirical function distribution
calibration.required_draw_policy: enumerate every unique predictor member exactly once
calibration.field_selection_rule: For each exact selector and fit fold, choose the smallest preregistered scale minimizing 2*mean-undercoverage + mean-absolute-coverage-error + 0.05*max(0, energy/identity-energy-1). Scales are >=1 and act around the unmodified ensemble mean.
calibration.applicability_fit_input: flatten predictor-member probabilities within fit designs; repeat the design label per member; apply the same slope/intercept to every member before member averaging

current_cost: each complete rawData member through current task calc_cost.py
objective central 50/80/90 percent coverage and energy score
per-draw reconstruction/projection wall time and observed RSS
acquisition_proxy: existing fixed-pool BoTorch qLogNEHVI backend only
q=1 all bounded candidates and deterministic q=2 pairs
same real evaluation count within each q
metrics.acquisition_boundary: This bounded calibration-pool decision proxy is not the complete 082611 strategy and is not the 082612 formal same-budget optimization benchmark.

thresholds.authority: These are framework-calibration artifact gates, not CAE architecture/performance acceptance thresholds.

acquisition_proxy_protocol.valid_rows: true and all raw/calibrated member costs finite and inside the current [0,1] contract
acquisition_proxy_protocol.q2: up to 64 deterministic non-repeating candidate pairs
acquisition_proxy_protocol.finite_support_policy: minimum unique support equals checkpoint predictor member count; reject below support

failure_rules.pre_access: Any source/artifact/checkpoint/signature/provenance/policy/split/access mismatch aborts before locator access.
failure_rules.rawdata: Any rawData/current-cost/acquisition-proxy gate failure writes an explicit uncalibrated identity-scale artifact; no selected nonidentity coefficient is exposed.
failure_rules.applicability: Insufficient class support, fit failure, or any applicability gate failure writes explicit uncalibrated status with no slope/intercept.
failure_rules.signature: Any state/strategy/schema/checkpoint hash mismatch rejects the artifact; no fallback coefficient reuse.
failure_rules.architecture: Every result remains experimental-performance-not-accepted regardless of calibration metrics; coefficients are non-transferable.
failure_rules.test: Offline-test access remains forbidden and no post-access threshold may be backfilled.

required_bindings: model file and canonical model-state hashes
checkpoint_contract.calibration_storage: A separate self-verifying calibration checkpoint adjunct binds the immutable base checkpoint; the development checkpoint is not mutated after freeze.

resources.scheduled_heartbeat_rule: Create only if actual remaining stage estimate exceeds one hour; otherwise follow the one foreground process to exit.
resources.posterior_rawdata_streaming_boundary: Only [draw,candidate,objective] persists after per-draw current-cost projection.

post_access_rule: After the first calibration locator read, split, calibrator family, candidate scales, seed, metrics, thresholds, failure rules, checkpoint/source hashes, and acquisition-proxy protocol are immutable. Any changed method requires a new preregistration and cannot reinterpret this result.
